'''Thomas Dowlings Asteroids & Probes (40 Card Jr. Deck)''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on Decipher Deck Designs.

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Thomas Dowlings]]
* '''Published:''' March 1998 (Decipher Deck Designs)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Cloud City]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' —
* '''Strategy:''' Asteroids & Probes (40 Card Jr. Deck)
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PCC Asteroids & Probes (40 Card Jr. Deck.txt |Download]]
